content.what_it_is: Python postprocessing script in the rip_tracking case directory; its content (identical source_sha256 to rip_2d/postprocessing/plot_eta_vor_commented.py) still targets the rip_2D case: fdir is built from $HOME/FUNWAVE-TVD/simple_cases/rip_2D/work/output (L13-L14) and output files are named rip_2d_2subplot_num_<num>.png (L92). User input section L2-L18. Loads dep.out (L22-L23), n,m from shape (L24), dx=1.0, dy=2.0 (L27-L28), coordinates via np.arange (L31-L32), meshgrid (L35). Console-interactive snapshot range (L37-L38; legacy comment nstart=280 L40). Per snapshot (L44-L93): zero-padded fnum (L48), loads umean_, vmean_, eta_, mask_ (L51-L54), NaN-masks all four fields where mask<1 (L57-L60). Panel 1 (subplot 121): eta pcolor with jet (L66), axis [0, m*dx/2, 0, n*dy] (L67), horizontal colorbar with 5-bin MaxNLocator labeled eta (m) (L68-L73), labels (L74-L75). Panel 2 (subplot 122): contourf of -dep, 10 levels, horizontal colorbar 'depth (m)' (L80-L82), quiver subsampled every everyWhich=6 points (L84-L88), xlabel and axis (L89-L90). Saves png at dpi=400 and shows the figure (L92-L93). No vorticity is computed despite the filename.
